svg.title: Eyekei Freighter - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 14-15, PDF 15-16. Combined two-deck projection follows broad lower cargo/fuel deck with flat chamfered nose, narrow forebody, rounded expanding rear shoulders and bevelled broad stern. Upper accommodation/engineering deck fits within it at matching grid scale. Illustration corroborates broad aft freighter hull; doors, crane and fuel-room borders excluded.
